=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- .github/workflows/internal-review.yml:50 | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [qwen_qwen3_6-plus]
  PROBLEM: github.actor on pull_request.synchronize does not identify the push actor, so the bot exemption does not work as intended.
  WHY: On autofix-triggered synchronize runs, the actor resolves to the PR author rather than the bot login, so the condition remains true and still cancels the earlier run.
- .github/workflows/internal-review.yml:50 (new expression on cancel-in-progress) | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [x-ai_grok-4_1-fast]
  PROBLEM: Comparing github.actor directly to the bot login can miss bot-formatted names such as codex[bot], so bot-triggered events may still evaluate as cancellable.
  WHY: The expression lacks normalization for GitHub's bot login variants, which can make the != check true unexpectedly.
- .github/workflows/internal-review.yml:50 (vars.AUTOFIX_BOT_LOGIN || 'codex') | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [x-ai_grok-4_1-fast]
  PROBLEM: Using vars.AUTOFIX_BOT_LOGIN || 'codex' prevents explicitly emptying the variable, so the repo cannot disable the default fallback by unsetting it.
  WHY: The expression coalesces falsy values to 'codex' instead of preserving an empty or intentionally disabled setting.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

- .github/workflows/internal-review.yml:50 | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: github.actor for pull_request events resolves to the PR author, not the push actor, so this guard does not detect autofix-bot synchronize runs.
  WHY: On a pull_request.synchronize event caused by the autofix bot's push, github.actor still names the PR creator, so the expression stays true and Run 1 is still cancelled.

=== FINDINGS FROM x-ai_grok-4_1-fast ===
- .github/workflows/internal-review.yml:50 (new expression on cancel-in-progress) | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: Expression assumes github.actor exactly matches the bot login string, but GitHub may append [bot] suffixes in some contexts, making the comparison fail.
  WHY: Raw login comparison without normalization can evaluate true unexpectedly for bot-triggered events.
- .github/workflows/internal-review.yml:50 (vars.AUTOFIX_BOT_LOGIN || 'codex') | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: No fallback handling if vars.AUTOFIX_BOT_LOGIN is explicitly set to empty string or falsy value, so the repo cannot disable the codex default by unsetting it.
  WHY: The `||` expression coalesces empty values to 'codex' instead of preserving an explicit empty setting.
=== END FINDINGS FROM x-ai_grok-4_1-fast ===
